description: The open and composable observability and data visualization platform.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Re-proven as offered on 2026-09-11: the first approval rested on a proof of CapRover's grafana/grafana:7.4.3, not the grafana-oss:13.0.2 this template installs, which a tightened guard caught. The re-run installed 13.0.2 for real and proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine and one architecture only.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Signs in with the user name and password `admin` on first start, and asks you to change it. Do that before pointing it at anything real.
